rules.name: Orthogonalization Mechanism (K628 Lesson)
rules.summary: When a strategy is BLOCKED-G5 (corr >= 0.40), identify the common FR factor driving the correlation, orthogonalize the signal by regressing out that factor (OLS residual), retest G5. If post-orthogonalization corr < 0.40, ACCEPT CONDITIONAL with 60d paper gate.
rules.key_parameters: β factor extraction via OLS IS, OOS R² as validation, G5 recheck on residual signal
rules.anti_pattern: Do NOT simply reject G5-blocked strategies. Always attempt factor extraction first (15min effort vs $100K+ profit unlock).

rules.name: ETH-base Triple Discriminator (K672)
rules.summary: For ETH-base to BEAT BTC-base: ALL 3 required. (1) vol_ratio_alt_ETH >= 2x [pre-screen, NECESSARY]. (2) Alt FR cycles align with ETH ecosystem (DeFi/staking/L2), NOT BTC institutional or payment cycles [NECESSARY, qualitative]. (3) alt-ETH FR raw corr < 0.45 [NECESSARY, orthogonality]. Accept rate: 3/11 = 27%. vol_ratio is most reliable single pre-screen.
rules.key_failures: SHIB (vol_ratio=1.89x < 2x), TRX (payment cycle ≠ ETH DeFi cycle), HYPE (AQAv2 self-referential degraded), INJ (vol_dominance block vol>3x)

rules.name: Load-bearing Factor Diagnostic (K634)
rules.summary: Before orthogonalizing, check if the removed factor is 'load-bearing' for the signal. If IS R² > 0.40 on the factor being removed, the factor may be providing genuine alpha (not just noise correlation). Distinguish: (A) spurious correlation = remove factor, keep alpha. (B) load-bearing = factor IS the alpha, removal destroys strategy.
rules.threshold: IS R² > 0.40 = load-bearing risk. Proceed with caution, verify OOS R² < 0.10 (no OOS factor predictability).

rules.name: Vol Pre-screen (K662/K663)
rules.summary: Vol ratio (alt FR vol / base FR vol) is the fastest reject signal for ETH-base evaluation. Compute in 2 minutes before running full backtest. If vol_ratio < 2x, ETH-base will likely be WORSE or at best marginal. Skip full test. Exception: SOL at 1.63x passed due to FR level proximity (SOL FR ≈ ETH FR level).
rules.source_waves: K662 (INJ vol=3.55x but G5b blocked), K663 (TIA vol=2.12x ACCEPT), K670 (SHIB vol=1.89x WORSE)

rules.name: Cycle Alignment (K667)
rules.summary: ETH-base works when the alt token's FR spikes align with ETH ecosystem cycles (DeFi narrative, staking rewards, L2 activity). Tokens with BTC-correlated institutional premium cycles (TRX payment, HYPE buyback) or meme retail cycles (SHIB) that differ from ETH DeFi cycles will be WORSE on ETH-base even if vol_ratio passes.
rules.source_wave: K667 (TRX payment vs ETH DeFi mismatch)
